description: This pie chart, titled “6 Matches,” visually represents the distribution of 6,000 matches across six distinct categories, labeled 0 through 5, with each slice showing its corresponding percentage, absolute count, and category number. The largest segment, colored light blue, corresponds to category 5 and accounts for 27.2% (8,006 matches). The second largest segment, light green, represents category 2 with 22.4% (6,583 matches). The third largest, pale yellow, is category 1 at 13.8% (4,046 matches). The fourth largest, off-white, is category 0 at 13.3% (3,910 matches). The fifth largest, light blue-green, is category 4 at 6.2% (1,810 matches). The smallest segment, pale green, corresponds to category 3 at 6.8% (2,002 matches). Each slice is clearly labeled with its percentage, count, and category number, and the chart includes a legend indicating the category number associated with each slice. The segments are arranged in descending order of size, clockwise from the top.
